petra.name: Interval + 100 Air Squats + cooldown

Severe calf soreness afterward. Air Squat ≠ Wall Ball counted reps, cool-down run may already be in Garmin runs; do not double count.

petra.name: AMRAP23 · 2人輪替
petra.detail: Alvin＋Leon，同隊成績。Partner A：12 DB Deadlift＋9 DB Hang Clean＋6 DB Push Press＋4 DB Forward Lunge；Partner B Easy Machine，完成後交換。Garmin 17:52 HIIT 23:11，均心169、最高192，時間吻合；非個人17輪。

petra.name: Front Squat + Push Press + Team Row
petra.detail: E2:30×4：12 BB Front Squat；E3MOM×3：8 BB Push Press＋12 Arm Pull on RowErg；雙人輪替 AMRAP10：10 Single-arm DB Thruster＋100m Row。未見個人分數，是否出席未證。

petra.name: AMRAP 28
petra.detail: 350m Run／Ski 或 Row、KB Swing、DB Front Rack Lunge；Garmin HIIT 26:38、平均心率 164、最高 186。白板旁註 12.5，重量歸屬未確認。

petra.name: 1500m Row
petra.detail: 白板 6:18；Garmin 6:20.5。保留兩個來源，不能擅自視為同一計時。

petra.name: Run + Sled + WB
petra.detail: 白板為最慢一輪；Garmin HIIT 平均心率 169、最高 189。

coach.headline: 下一個突破點不是更快的400m，而是恢復良好後讓8公里跑＋8個站點更穩。
coach.summary: 11/12 Petra間歇實際含5×~400m＋4×~600m，結束後另做100 Air Squat與兩圈緩跑；Alvin回報小腿明顯痠痛。這次不應直接診斷小腿肌耐力不足：可能是高跑速/推蹬、近期跑量和後續下肢訓練堆疊所致。第一優先是評估步行、上樓與提踵的反應，恢復之前暫緩快速跑、爆發跳躍與高量Wall Ball。原有Petra＋World Gym 5–6天彈性模組維持，但訓練強度依恢復改動；長期目標仍是有氧底盤、站點後可跑及三大項漸進。

findings.title: v1.3 PPL + 真正Station主課
findings.body: WorldGym Mon Legs、Tue Pull、Fri Push（WFH）。Sun/Mon/Tue最多可選一堂Petra Strength/Skill，非必到，按肌群替代。Wed WOD隔週選配，Thu固定跑。Sat主Station通常4–5 rounds、22–40分，力量後2輪只屬低強度技巧收尾；Wed若硬WOD則Sat取消。

findings.title: 小腿痠痛是暫時調課訊號，不是弱項診斷
findings.body: 這次高強度間歇後再做100 Air Squat＋兩圈緩跑；疼痛/僵硬若影響步行、單腳提踵或隔天更重，就取消衝刺和高量站點，先用低強度Row/Bike取代。單側腫脹、急性劇痛需評估。

findings.title: 有氧底盤比多一堂全力WOD更有價值
findings.body: 11/02完整週跑量25.84km高於先前12–16km常態，下一階段優先穩定Long Easy 45–60分鐘和低強度Erg，而不是繼續推400m極速。

findings.title: Petra WOD就是混合耐力課，不要重複計量
findings.body: 11/10雙人AMRAP23團隊17R+15（非個人），Garmin均心169；11/12為一堂包含400m及600m間歇、100 Air Squat和緩跑的課，不能分拆當作三堂。

findings.title: 增肌優先 + 功能性整合，WOD是獨立一堂
findings.body: World Gym改Push/Pull/Legs：前半段高品質增肌工作組，後半段相關HYROX技巧與穩定。另有正式World Gym/Home WOD；若Petra WOD有去直接替換。Petra Strength/Skill課可替代相同肌群課，不當第7堂強制加課。

coach.limitation: Garmin 64 activities and FIT 204 segments updated Nov13. 11/12 100 Air Squats + two cooldown laps and postexercise calf soreness are user-reported, not independently timed/quantified by FIT. Calf symptoms cannot establish injury or weak muscular endurance alone. Strength log missing verified Squat/Bench/Trap-bar loads; no fabricated kg or percentage 1RM. Team shared 11/10 17R+15 not individual score.

phases.label: BUILD THE BASE
phases.head: 力量＋低強度有氧
phases.detail: 維持三大項、每週 1 次主要品質跑；把長 Easy 跑逐步從 6–7km 提升到 8–10km（依恢復調整）。

phases.label: RACE TRANSFER
phases.head: 力量變成站點能力
phases.detail: 引入 Run→Sled／Wall Ball／Lunge；跑完站點後以可控速度重啟 1km，替代部分一般 WOD，不在既有強度上疊加。

phases.label: SPECIFICITY
phases.head: 雙日模擬與配速
phases.detail: World Gym 減為約 2 堂維持；與 Stacy 做一次縮量雙日模擬，練混雙不透支及男單的慢開局、Wall Ball 分組。

phases.label: TAPER
phases.head: 恢復、不是再練爆
phases.detail: 賽前約 10–14 天逐步減量 40–60%，保留少量速度與力量感，避免高傷害風險 WOD、安排睡眠和補給。

phases.label: RACE WEEKEND
phases.head: 先控制、再穩穩完賽
phases.detail: 週五與 Stacy 混雙不追全力 PR；完賽後補水／碳水／休息。週六男單先穩住前兩公里，再按心肺與腿部感覺完成各站。

flexiblePlan.fiveDayRule: Do not invent six completed sessions. If only five days, choose PPL three days, Thu Petra running, and either Saturday Station main or Sunday Easy/Long depending on recovery and whether Wed Petra WOD covered Station; missed slot not force-made-up.
flexiblePlan.sixDayRule: PPL Mon/Tue/Fri plus Thu Interval, Sat Station when no Wed hard Petra WOD, Sun Easy/Long; if Wed hard Petra WOD it replaces Sat Station and Thu scaled. This is a maximum template, not a rigid attendance demand.
flexiblePlan.petraPolicy: Petra Strength or Skill can ONLY be attended on one day among Sunday, Monday, Tuesday per week; may be zero. Wed Petra WOD separate optional. Actual attendance must be confirmed, not inferred from photo.
flexiblePlan.mainStationPolicy: 4–5 rounds 22–40min with Ski emphasis, controlled rests; W01/W04/W08/W12/W16 0–3 easy rounds are technique ONLY; W14 Fri eight-station short simulation replaces Push.
flexiblePlan.finisherPolicy: 0–2 easy rounds RPE≤5 after Legs/Push do NOT count as main station training. Do not extrapolate 2 rounds to adequate work capacity stimulus.
flexiblePlan.runningPolicy: Thu Petra Interval+Sunday Long Easy flexible; other short Easy optional by recovery. Ski/Row metres never become run kms.
ordering: Fixed Thu Petra Interval first, Wed hard WOD only if it can coexist by scaling Thu; no automatic stacked Wed+Thu full intensity
Keep Fri WFH Push as an anchor, Mon Legs and Tue Pull as other two strength topics
Petra Strength/Skill Sun/Mon/Tue max one optional attendance; replace same muscle volume, never add compulsory seventh day
Sat Station main only if no Wed hard Petra WOD and adequate Thu recovery
Deload W04/W08/W12, taper W16, W14 Fri mini simulation, W17 races

adaptiveChecks.action: Replace matching muscle-group World Gym sets (Skill does not necessarily count as heavy strength), move/reduce Sunday Long Easy if necessary
Thu Petra running class Easy/Tech or scale with coach; Sat Station main cancelled; if Thu unscalable prefer skipping Wed hard WOD

adaptiveChecks.signal: Thu Petra Interval hard, Sat not recovered
adaptiveChecks.action: Reduce Sat station rounds/intensity or skip and do easy erg/rest
Do not label this as completed station main. Main 4–5 rounds is Sat if performed.

adaptiveChecks.signal: knee swelling, calf pain changing gait
adaptiveChecks.action: Stop provocative high-impact/high-load station movements, recover, seek clinical assessment if persistent

flexiblePlan.selectionRationale: Official HYROX 8×1km run + stations requires both running and station ability, with ACSM 2026 progressive resistance training and individualized total load. Workouts are personalized coaching prescriptions, not a precise physiological performance prediction.

bridge.title: 小腿恢復優先（條件調整）

plan.text: 已有5.86km Garmin跑步；若小腿仍痠，不再補快速跑或高次數深蹲。
步行/活動度20–30分；若走路痛或跛行不補跑。可坐姿上肢、輕Row/Bike 15–25分且全程舒適。
若步行、樓梯、提踵均舒適且隔天無反彈，Easy 20–30分起步；否則Bike/Row Easy 20–40分或休息。
若仍明顯痠痛，不做快跑、Sled衝刺、高量Wall Ball；以World Gym Bench/Back或休息替代。

prescriptionEngine.source: Garmin FIT (64 activities, 204 laps), 37 Petra indexed photos (new IMG_1702), ACSM 2026 resistance statement, official HYROX station format

loadGuide.main: Squat/Bench/Trap-bar 首次只根據當天熱身找工作重量：先做空槓或很輕重量8次 → 逐步增加重量做5/3次；工作組要能完成目標次數且還能多做2–3次（RIR2–3），最後一組速度不明顯崩落，下一次才增加2.5–5kg（視動作與器材，非強制）。
loadGuide.wallball: Men Open / Mixed標準參考6kg、3.0m目標（以賽事最新規則為準）；訓練先以6kg動作正確為先，若連6次穩定目標都做不到可先降4kg練動作，不追數量。
loadGuide.sled: Men Open / Mixed賽事標準參考Push 152kg / Pull 103kg（含雪橇本體）；World Gym地板與摩擦不一定相同，訓練以10m能持續推/拉、RPE6–7、姿勢穩定為準，記錄實際器械總重量；不要直接套比賽公斤。
loadGuide.ergo: SkiErg自報1000m約5:00（2:30/500m），技術間歇每150m RPE5–6、約40–55秒可控完成；RowErg白板1500m6:18、Garmin6:20.5，Easy訓練以能說話RPE3–4，不強制追配速。
loadGuide.safety: 每堂高強度前後暖身與降溫；膝蓋腫脹、疼痛、明顯不穩則取消重腿/跳躍與加負荷，必要時物理治療或醫師評估。

exercises.load: 當天工作重量RIR3；未知kg先建立基準

B.option: 若腿部不適，可優先這堂上肢。恢復良好才補20–25分鐘Easy Ski/Row；本週小腿敏感時選Bike/Row舒適強度。

C.title: World Gym C · 六角槓＋Station
C.warmup: Bike 5分＋髖髂動態暖身＋六角槓漸進熱身

exercises.load: RIR3，雙腿近兩日重訓則減為2×4
先2×12–16kg作技巧起點，肩胛姿勢穩再進步至賽事2×24kg
先徒手或5–10kg、膝穩定；賽事標準20kg供長期參考

C.option: Trap-bar及Sled僅在正常步態與小腿耐受下做；站點只選一項、避免當週Petra已有大量Wall Ball/跳躍或重腿，任何不適即取消。

B5.title: 5天合併版 · 臥推＋六角槓＋背
B5.warmup: 5分鐘有氧＋大項分別遞增熱身
B5.option: 臥推優先；若小腿仍不適，Trap-bar完全取消改做背部，這週不追三大項補齊。不要加高強度WOD。

weeks.aim: 小腿恢復與安全回到連續跑；先恢復，再建立三大項RIR基準和有氧底盤
weeks.running: 若小腿仍明顯痠/行走或提踵痛：Petra Interval改30–40分Easy Bike/Row，Long Easy改20–40分舒適交叉訓練；完全恢復後才做可控Interval並減20–30%工作量，Long Easy先從40–45分開始，翌日症狀穩定再加。
weeks.volume: 不強制追16–20km；將症狀和次日反應當作本週第一KPI。Squat/Bench 2–3×5 RIR3；Trap-bar最多2×4且僅在小腿舒適時做。
weeks.progression: 記錄疼痛/僵硬、能否正常步行與單腳提踵、實際負重kg/RIR。先穩住疼痛反應，不急著加重量、跑量或Wall Ball。

wod.title: ENGINE CONTROL 12
wod.duration: 12分鐘主課；含暖身、冷卻共約25–30分鐘
wod.priority: 復原條件選配，完全不必完成
wod.target: 只有無痛、恢復好才進行：每分鐘保留15秒以上、RPE不超過6；若小腿緊或技術變差立即停下。
wod.swap: 小腿仍痠、提踵不舒適、Petra Strength為硬WOD，三者任一成立就取消整堂EMOM；改Easy Row/Bike 15–25分鐘或休息。6kg Wall Ball不是必做。

weeks.aim: 症狀已穩定時，重新建立有氧時間＋小腿力量耐受＋低強度站點效率
weeks.running: 先完成30–45分鐘無不良次日反應的Easy；之後Long Easy50–55分，Interval保持可控而非加速。若小腿反應不佳延續W1恢復方案。
weeks.volume: 週跑量17–22km（若W01恢復好）；主要動作增1次rep或加2.5kg其中一個，不同週同時加WOD量。
weeks.progression: 只增加一種變量（Easy時間或主要力量負重）；不能三項同時提高。

wod.title: HYBRID FLOW 18
wod.duration: 8分鐘暖身＋18分鐘主課＋5分鐘緩和=31分鐘
wod.priority: 條件選配；只在Petra Strength未做硬WOD時安排

rounds.load: 起點徒手或雙手各4–8kg，膝舒適

wod.target: 每輪結束主動休15–30秒，18分鐘完成幾輪不追排名；平均RPE6，最高RPE7。
wod.swap: 若仍有小腿痠/跑步時痛、最近Petra已有高心率WOD或腿部疲勞，此AMRAP整堂取消，改20–30分鐘Easy Row；不要勉強完成300m跑＋Lunge＋Wall Ball。

weeks.aim: 減量週：主要工作組減30–40%，用較低衝擊的Technique維持動作品質和恢復
weeks.running: Petra Interval減工作段20–30%或改簡短節奏練習；Long Easy 40–45分鐘輕鬆完成
weeks.volume: 週跑量13–17km；Squat/Bench各2×5 RIR4，Trap-bar 2×3 RIR4，其餘配件縮短1/3
weeks.progression: 不測PR、不加重量，睡眠和關節恢復優先。

wod.title: TECHNIQUE RESET 12
wod.priority: 只有恢復正常才做，亦可完全跳過
wod.target: 每輪3分鐘內保留至少45–60秒休息，主觀RPE≤5，總量Ski600m、Row600m、WB24次。
wod.swap: 不論本週WOD有無達成均可取消；小腿或膝蓋不舒服時Wall Ball改上肢穩定動作，划船/滑雪只舒適節奏。

weeks.aim: 恢復狀態良好才開始標準化run→station銜接，逐步提升有氧混合耐力
weeks.running: Petra Interval照教練但避免和本週混合WOD都衝滿；Long Easy 50–60分鐘；WOD中跑量納入總週跑量
weeks.volume: 週跑量17–22km（包含WOD中的跑步）；Squat/Bench 3×5、Trap-bar 2–3×4 RIR2–3，依恢復調整
weeks.progression: 單站點與跑步轉換更流暢，不需衝更快400m。

wod.title: COMPROMISED RUN 45
wod.duration: 10分鐘暖身＋24分鐘主課＋6分鐘技巧檢查＋5分鐘冷卻
wod.priority: 條件選配／取代當週其他硬WOD或減短Petra Interval
wod.target: 每輪留45–90秒恢復，累計2km跑＋600m Ski＋32WB，總RPE約6–7。若無法完成或剩不到30秒，先降跑步至400m。
wod.swap: 若小腿曾在跑步後疼痛再發、Petra本週已有硬WOD、或24–48小時腿部負荷很高，取消此45分鐘混合課並改Easy Row/Bike或縮短跑步距離；不是額外第三個高強度日。

weeklyRules: Petra Class為固定內容（非本系統編排），依當週實際白板與Garmin成績分類為力量或混合高強度。
一週5堂優先Petra Strength、Petra Interval、World Gym A、World Gym B5與Long Easy；6堂可拆成World Gym A/B/C且選WOD僅替換C尾段。
重蹲與Trap-bar儘量相隔約48小時，高強度跑前避免24小時內重腿；不足則RIR提高、減組或改上肢。
每週最多1–2個主要高強度刺激，EMOM/AMRAP的RPE和休息都可調，不鼓勵每次限時把自己練爆。
膝蓋疼痛腫脹等症狀優先停重腿、Wall Ball/跳躍動作，不強迫完成設計。
11/12後的小腿痠痛需主動影響處方：走路痛或提踵明顯疼痛就取消跑步Interval、Sled高強度、爆發跳與Wall Ball大組，改Easy Bike/Row或上肢；先恢復再逐步加量。
每次World Gym力量後若安排站點，跑步/Wall Ball/Sled應視前48小時Petra白板與Garmin實績削減，不能同一週重複堆多堂高強度。

calfStrengthPrescription.frequency: 2×/week after symptoms settle; at least 48h apart
calfStrengthPrescription.phase1: Standing calf raise straight-knee 2×10–12 and bent-knee 2×10–12, controlled 2 sec up/down, bodyweight or supported, no next-day flare
calfStrengthPrescription.phase2: 3×12–15; once stable add 2–5kg slowly, one variable at a time, stop before form deteriorates
calfStrengthPrescription.hold: If walking hurts or single-leg calf raise provokes discomfort, substitute ankle range-of-motion and rest, do not attempt loaded raises or intervals
calfStrengthPrescription.returnRun: Try 20–30min easy on level ground only after normal walking and a comfortable controlled heel raise. Monitor next-day soreness; delay hard running until easy running is consistently tolerated.
calfStrengthPrescription.source: NHS Inform calf advice and Berkshire NHS return-to-running symptoms guide; coaching adaptation, not diagnosis

prescriptionEngine.legacyStrengthWarning: 本物件的舊strength欄位為歷史參考；最新版課表以seasonPlan.weeks[].sessions[].classPlan的Push/Pull/Legs/WOD為唯一有效處方。

calfRecovery.trigger: 2026-11-12 interval class including 5×~400m, 4×~600m, post-interval 100 air squats simulating Wall Ball, and 2 laps easy cooldown jogging
calfRecovery.symptom: Calves very sore after interval session; side, exact location, pain intensity, duration, swelling and gait changes not yet known
calfRecovery.interpretation: Could reflect novel intensity, fast push-off, accumulated run/load, or muscle soreness; cannot diagnose lack of calf endurance from soreness alone.
checklist: Check walking, stairs and normal heel raise without limping or worsening pain before next running workout.
Do not schedule hard intervals, jumps, explosive sleds or high-rep Wall Ball while calf soreness changes movement or escalates.
Symptoms still clearly painful or worse beyond 48 hours, focal tenderness/swelling, sharp pain or inability to walk normally: pause impact training and seek evaluation.
Sudden one-sided swelling, redness/warmth, chest pain or unexplained breathlessness needs prompt medical assessment.
Use comfortable easy Bike or Row only if movements do not worsen symptoms, rather than forcing mileage to hit targets.

gradedBuild.entry: While noticeably sore or walking painful
gradedBuild.dose: Comfortable walking, ankle motion 1–2min several times/day; easy Bike/Row 15–30min RPE2–3 if symptom-free
gradedBuild.progress: Do not force stretches, deep loaded calf raises, running, burpee jumps, sled or Wall Ball.

gradedBuild.entry: Walking, stairs and 10 smooth controlled single-leg heel raises are comfortable; soreness not worsening next morning
gradedBuild.dose: Standing calf raise straight knee 2×10–12 + bent-knee calf raise 2×10–12, slow 2sec up/2sec down, 2 sessions/week
gradedBuild.progress: Bodyweight/assisted first; leave at least 48h between sessions. If sore afterward, reduce reps.

gradedBuild.entry: Two symptom-stable sessions & next-day response acceptable
gradedBuild.dose: Build to 3×12–15 both straight- and bent-knee; then add small external load (2–5kg) one variable at time; 2/week
gradedBuild.progress: Add 1 controlled easy run of 20–30min before resuming interval intensity. Increase easy run duration gradually.

gradedBuild.entry: Easy run, hopping and loaded lunges comfortable; no delayed flare
gradedBuild.dose: Wall Ball 2×10 at 6kg (or 4kg for clean movement), sled technique 2–3×10m RPE5–6, run→station transition short reps
gradedBuild.progress: Do not increase run volume and station volume together; reduce if next-day calf response deteriorates.

weekRules: 11/14–11/16 consider recovery; after pronounced soreness prioritize symptom-led progression rather than completing planned weekly kilometers.
Week 1 (11/16–11/22) run intervals only if comfortable with normal walking/calf loading; otherwise replace Petra Interval with easy Row/Bike and cut impact load.
Heavy Squat or Trap-bar work allowed only if normal calf function and knee symptoms; keep RIR≥3 and reduce to 2 work sets if not fully recovered.
Only restore WOD with Wall Ball/Run/Lunge once calf symptoms have normalized; existing Petra hard WOD remains one of the weekly hard stimuli.
calfRecovery.note: Return-to-running thresholds here are conservative coaching guardrails, not diagnosis or guarantee; discuss ongoing or severe pain with a clinician.

references.title: Berkshire Healthcare NHS - return to running

blocks.name: 技術重建與恢復
blocks.theme: W01–03 以Squat／Bench／拉背及六角槓技術建立工作組；W04 降載。基礎動作優先於高心率補量。
blocks.target: 建立可記錄的kg/reps/RIR，避免小腿反彈

blocks.name: 增肌容量＋有氧擴充
blocks.theme: W05–07 以連續三週的六角槓力量與臥推漸進，Squat作次主項，維持背部肌量；W08降載。
blocks.target: 胸背腿進步而不犧牲Long Easy

blocks.name: 肌耐力與跑站銜接
blocks.theme: W09–11 保留少量高品質Squat/Bench/Hinge，力量維持讓位給Run→Station、Sled、Carry與Wall Ball；W12降載。

blocks.name: HYROX專項與雙日策略
blocks.theme: W13–15 只保留必要的力量刺激，W14縮量八站模擬期間取消重硬舉；重點是隔天仍能恢復。
blocks.target: 完成縮量雙日測試而不造成過度痠痛

blocks.name: TAPER與比賽
blocks.theme: W16 降低力量訓練量，不再做重型硬舉；W17週五混雙、週六男單。
blocks.target: 保留動作感與恢復，優先安全完賽

weeks.focus: Push 起步後：拉力平衡與基礎建立
weeks.why: 基礎動作品質；避免硬舉或雪橇衝刺；Station進展照每週原有WOD與有氧課進行。
weeks.priority: 先讓小腿恢復，不能跑就換低衝擊有氧

target.aerobic: Long Easy 40分鐘（能交談；按Garmin恢復調整）
target.quality: 跑步品質課1堂（另見Running）＋多站WOD約18分 RPE6；WOD內跑步0.6km 已計入跑量
target.strength: PPL增肌主項1組基準 @RIR 4（其他輔助動作依堂課）；功能性2輪

sessions.name: Petra Strength/Skill only SUN/MON/TUE (optional one) + Wed WOD separate
sessions.purpose: Substitute matched World Gym muscle groups, not stack
sessions.details: Petra WOD separate optional WED only; actual attendance verified

sessions.name: THU · PETRA RUNNING INTERVAL
sessions.purpose: Fixed Thursday interval, no WorldGym
sessions.details: Easy/Technique RPE3–5

classPlan.subtitle: PETRA INTERVAL｜週四固定跑課
classPlan.warmup: 5–10分鐘循序漸進暖身＋主要槓鈴動作的準備組

blocks.title: THURSDAY Running Interval
steps: 小腿恢復/減量週，只做Easy或技術跑，必要時取消高速間歇
疼痛或步態異常不硬跑，記錄隔天反應
週四不進World Gym；Garmin記實跑距離、Lap、HR、Session RPE
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

classPlan.notes: 週四固定Petra跑課，不安排World Gym。Wed硬WOD與Thu硬Interval不可都全力

sessions.name: FRI · PUSH (WFH WORLD GYM)
sessions.purpose: Friday main Push strength slot (simulation exception W14)
sessions.details: Bench/Incline/Shoulder, easy WB technique 0–2 rounds optional

classPlan.subtitle: PUSH｜World Gym 臥推＋肩（三大力量日）
classPlan.warmup: 5–10分鐘循序漸進暖身＋主要槓鈴動作的準備組

blocks.title: PUSH · A Bench / Chest
steps: Bench Press 2×5–8 @RIR4
Incline DB Press 1×8–10 @RIR4
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

blocks.title: PUSH · B Shoulder / Triceps
steps: Seated DB Shoulder Press 1×8–10
Lateral Raise 1×12–15
Cable Triceps Pressdown 1×10–12
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

blocks.title: PUSH · C WB Finisher
steps: 選配：Wall Ball 6kg ×8 ×2輪，腿/膝未恢復就不做
Pallof Press 2×10/側，絕不把兩輪技巧當作正式Station主課
若週三硬WOD且週四還跑Interval，這段直接跳過
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

blocks.title: 週五 WFH 與 Petra 替代
blocks.format: Fri World Gym 高機率出席
steps: 週五主要是Push力量主課，不再預設成恢復日
如果Sun/Mon/Tue的Petra Strength練了同肌群Push，週五減少相同組數，避免硬堆
週四已跑Petra，不要週五順便加一堂硬Station
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

classPlan.notes: Fri WFH大概率World Gym；明確Push主課。Wall Ball 0–2輪僅技巧，Station主課排Sat

sessions.name: TUE · PULL
sessions.purpose: Upper back pull + easy Ski technique
sessions.details: No heavy squat/hinge, no extra hard station

classPlan.subtitle: PULL｜World Gym 背部拉力＋Ski技巧
classPlan.warmup: 5–10分鐘循序漸進暖身＋主要槓鈴動作的準備組

blocks.title: PULL · A Vertical / Horizontal
steps: Lat Pulldown / Assisted Pull-up 2×6–10 @RIR4
Chest-supported Row 2×8–12 @RIR4
One-arm DB Row 1×8–10/側
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

blocks.title: PULL · B Upper Back + Biceps
steps: Face Pull 1×12–15
DB Curl 1×10–12
這天不排重深蹲或重硬舉，避免和週三WOD/週四跑課衝突
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

blocks.title: PULL · C Easy Ski Technique
steps: SkiErg輕鬆做6–12分鐘，保持手臂／軀幹動作一致
若隔天可能上Petra WOD或上肢已累，直接省略
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

blocks.title: Petra Strength / Skill 動態替代
steps: 如果週二去Petra Strength/Pull，替代World Gym Pull對應部位組數
如果只上了輕Skill，記錄技巧但不當作全部背部有效力量組數
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

classPlan.notes: Tue獨立Pull力量日，不再摻Bench或重腿。Petra Skill/Strength週二可取代

sessions.name: MON · LEGS
sessions.purpose: Independent squat + hinge strength
sessions.details: 0–2 easy round finisher is not Station main

classPlan.subtitle: LEGS｜World Gym 深蹲＋髖伸
classPlan.warmup: 5–10分鐘循序漸進暖身＋主要槓鈴動作的準備組

blocks.title: LEGS · A Squat / Hinge
steps: Back Squat 2×5–6 @RIR4
Romanian Deadlift 1×6–8 @RIR4
記錄實際重量、sets/reps/RIR；Squat與Hinge不要都練到力竭
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

blocks.title: LEGS · B Single Leg / Hamstring
steps: Reverse Lunge 或 Step-up 1×6–8/腿（若小腿/膝無痛）
Leg Curl 1×8–12
Low Step-down 1–2×8/腿；疼痛或腫脹時減少腿量
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

blocks.title: LEGS · C TECHNIQUE Finisher
steps: 選配：Sled Push 10m（技術負重）＋Easy Row 150m，最多2輪
這2輪只是腿日收尾，不計入當週Station主課的容量
有Petra腿部Strength、高強度WOD或腿痛就不做Finisher
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

blocks.title: Petra Strength / Skill 動態替代
blocks.format: 只能SUN / MON / TUE 其中一天，最多一堂，可不去
steps: 如果週一去Petra Strength，按實際練到的肌群取代World Gym腿日相應組數；別重複練一遍
如果是Skill輕技巧，不能假設已完成全部有效力量組數；可降低週量或下週再補
不為湊滿訓練天數堆疊額外課
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

classPlan.notes: Mon主練腿、蹲與髖伸。2輪技巧Finisher≠Station主課；Petra週一Strength可替代

sessions.name: SAT · STATION TECHNIQUE
sessions.purpose: Recovery/taper technique, not main
sessions.details: No Wed hard Petra WOD + adequate Thu recovery required

classPlan.subtitle: STATION TECHNIQUE｜RECOVERY EASY ERG
classPlan.warmup: 5–10分鐘循序漸進暖身＋主要槓鈴動作的準備組

blocks.title: 恢復／減量的技巧課（不是Station主課）
steps: SkiErg 10–12分鐘＋RowErg 5–10分鐘，RPE3；可選2×150m Ski技巧
小腿/膝恢復不佳則休息；本週不是正式Station主課
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

classPlan.notes: 2輪只在恢復週當技巧收尾，非正式Station容量訓練

sessions.purpose: Easy running base or optional Petra class substitution
sessions.details: Flexible; no forced long run after Sat hard station

classPlan.subtitle: LONG EASY｜戶外跑／Petra Strength·Skill選配
classPlan.warmup: 5–10分鐘循序漸進暖身＋主要槓鈴動作的準備組

blocks.title: Long Easy / Aerobic Base
steps: 戶外Easy Run 30–40分鐘，能講完整句子
如週六Station使腿部疲勞，縮短或改日；腿/膝有痛則改無痛低衝擊或休息
Ski/Row距離不能計入實際跑量
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

blocks.title: Petra Strength / Skill
blocks.format: SUN、MON、TUE其中一天可選，最多一堂
steps: 週日若去Petra Strength或Skill，根據實際肌群與RPE替代相似World Gym訓練；Long Easy可移日或取消
若週一或週二去Petra，週日就不再加第二堂Petra Strength/Skill
完全沒有去Petra Strength/Skill也是正常執行方案，不必補課
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

classPlan.notes: Sunday Long Easy，或至多一堂Sun/Mon/Tue的Petra Strength/Skill作替代，不需要兩者都做

weeks.check: 11/14 Push主項重量／RIR＋Push Station技巧；W01 Pull、Legs與Ski/Row基線
notes: 不要同週同時增加跑量、力量重量和站點次數
依當週 Garmin＋Petra 更新已完成刺激後再微調
Petra高強度已足時Engine改Z2；長跑日晚上可加非高強度雙訓。
正式WOD一週僅1堂，由Petra、World Gym或Home擇一。
5天版不會假裝能同時完成3堂增肌＋跑間歇＋長跑＋WOD：輪流練2個肌群主軸，6天才完整3分化。
本週HYROX增肌與WOD劑量按periodization調整，力量先有效組數再做同主題功能循環。
獨立WOD僅一堂，若Petra上WOD即替代；日程按家庭時間與恢復自由排列。

structure.fiveDayRule: Preserve three PPL topics when possible, Thursday Petra running and one of Sat Station / Sun Easy depending on recovery; don't force missed workout makeups.
structure.sixDayRule: Mon Legs Tue Pull Fri Push + Thu Running + Sat conditional Main Station + Sun movable Easy/Long. Optional Petra Strength/Skill Sun/Mon/Tue substitutes matched work, Wed Petra WOD substitutes Sat.
structure.recover: If calf/knee symptoms or persistent DOMS, lower volume, take Easy/Rest and do not stack hard sessions.

periodization.weeklyRule: Mon LEGS／Tue PULL／Fri PUSH（WFH）。Petra Strength/Skill僅Sun/Mon/Tue選一堂，非必去；Wed WOD可選，Thu固定跑課。本週TECHNIQUE_ONLY僅技巧／特殊模擬。力量後0–2輪不算Station主課。

本週HYROX增肌與WOD劑量按periodization調整，力量先有效組數再做同主題功能循環。
獨立WOD僅一堂，若Petra上WOD即替代；日程按家庭時間與恢復自由排列。

notes: 不要同週同時增加跑量、力量重量和站點次數

weeks.check: 睡眠、腿部反應和跑步心率回穩
notes: 不要同週同時增加跑量、力量重量和站點次數
減量不是退步，是給適應發生的空間
Petra高強度已足時Engine改Z2；長跑日晚上可加非高強度雙訓。
正式WOD一週僅1堂，由Petra、World Gym或Home擇一。
5天版不會假裝能同時完成3堂增肌＋跑間歇＋長跑＋WOD：輪流練2個肌群主軸，6天才完整3分化。
本週HYROX增肌與WOD劑量按periodization調整，力量先有效組數再做同主題功能循環。
獨立WOD僅一堂，若Petra上WOD即替代；日程按家庭時間與恢復自由排列。

structure.fiveDayRule: Preserve three PPL topics when possible, Thursday Petra running and one of Sat Station / Sun Easy depending on recovery; don't force missed workout makeups.
structure.sixDayRule: Mon Legs Tue Pull Fri Push + Thu Running + Sat conditional Main Station + Sun movable Easy/Long. Optional Petra Strength/Skill Sun/Mon/Tue substitutes matched work, Wed Petra WOD substitutes Sat.
structure.recover: If calf/knee symptoms or persistent DOMS, lower volume, take Easy/Rest and do not stack hard sessions.

periodization.weeklyRule: Mon LEGS／Tue PULL／Fri PUSH（WFH）。Petra Strength/Skill僅Sun/Mon/Tue選一堂，非必去；Wed WOD可選，Thu固定跑課。本週TECHNIQUE_ONLY僅技巧／特殊模擬。力量後0–2輪不算Station主課。

periodization.strengthAnchor: PPL: Mon LEGS / Tue PULL / Fri PUSH

weeks.why: 轉換第1週：硬舉維持，不追重；WOD練跑後Ski/BBJ；Station進展照每週原有WOD與有氧課進行。
weeks.priority: 練跑後上Ski與站點後前200m穩定節奏

target.aerobic: Long Easy 55分鐘（能交談；按Garmin恢復調整）
target.quality: 跑步品質課1堂（另見Running）＋多站WOD約35分 RPE8；WOD內跑步1.6km 已計入跑量
target.strength: PPL增肌主項3組基準 @RIR 2（其他輔助動作依堂課）；功能性3輪

sessions.name: Petra Strength/Skill only SUN/MON/TUE (optional one) + Wed WOD separate
sessions.purpose: Substitute matched World Gym muscle groups, not stack
sessions.details: Petra WOD separate optional WED only; actual attendance verified

sessions.name: THU · PETRA RUNNING INTERVAL
sessions.purpose: Fixed Thursday interval, no WorldGym
sessions.details: 主要品質跑 RPE7–8

classPlan.subtitle: PETRA INTERVAL｜週四固定跑課
classPlan.warmup: 5–10分鐘循序漸進暖身＋主要槓鈴動作的準備組

blocks.title: THURSDAY Running Interval
steps: 依Petra教練當天實際Interval跑課進行，約RPE7–8，不要求每組Max
跑後不要再加100下Air Squat或大量Wall Ball
週四不進World Gym；Garmin記實跑距離、Lap、HR、Session RPE
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

classPlan.notes: 週四固定Petra跑課，不安排World Gym。Wed硬WOD與Thu硬Interval不可都全力

sessions.name: FRI · PUSH (WFH WORLD GYM)
sessions.purpose: Friday main Push strength slot (simulation exception W14)
sessions.details: Bench/Incline/Shoulder, easy WB technique 0–2 rounds optional

classPlan.subtitle: PUSH｜World Gym 臥推＋肩（三大力量日）
classPlan.warmup: 5–10分鐘循序漸進暖身＋主要槓鈴動作的準備組

blocks.title: PUSH · A Bench / Chest
steps: Bench Press 3×5–8 @RIR2
Incline DB Press 3×8–10 @RIR2
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

blocks.title: PUSH · B Shoulder / Triceps
steps: Seated DB Shoulder Press 2×8–10
Lateral Raise 2×12–15
Cable Triceps Pressdown 2×10–12
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

blocks.title: PUSH · C WB Finisher
steps: 選配：Wall Ball 6kg ×8 ×2輪，腿/膝未恢復就不做
Pallof Press 2×10/側，絕不把兩輪技巧當作正式Station主課
若週三硬WOD且週四還跑Interval，這段直接跳過
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

blocks.title: 週五 WFH 與 Petra 替代
blocks.format: Fri World Gym 高機率出席
steps: 週五主要是Push力量主課，不再預設成恢復日
如果Sun/Mon/Tue的Petra Strength練了同肌群Push，週五減少相同組數，避免硬堆
週四已跑Petra，不要週五順便加一堂硬Station
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

classPlan.notes: Fri WFH大概率World Gym；明確Push主課。Wall Ball 0–2輪僅技巧，Station主課排Sat

sessions.name: TUE · PULL
sessions.purpose: Upper back pull + easy Ski technique
sessions.details: No heavy squat/hinge, no extra hard station

classPlan.subtitle: PULL｜World Gym 背部拉力＋Ski技巧
classPlan.warmup: 5–10分鐘循序漸進暖身＋主要槓鈴動作的準備組

blocks.title: PULL · A Vertical / Horizontal
steps: Lat Pulldown / Assisted Pull-up 3×6–10 @RIR2
Chest-supported Row 3×8–12 @RIR2
One-arm DB Row 2×8–10/側
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

blocks.title: PULL · B Upper Back + Biceps
steps: Face Pull 2×12–15
DB Curl 2×10–12
這天不排重深蹲或重硬舉，避免和週三WOD/週四跑課衝突
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

blocks.title: PULL · C Easy Ski Technique
steps: SkiErg輕鬆做6–12分鐘，保持手臂／軀幹動作一致
若隔天可能上Petra WOD或上肢已累，直接省略
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

blocks.title: Petra Strength / Skill 動態替代
steps: 如果週二去Petra Strength/Pull，替代World Gym Pull對應部位組數
如果只上了輕Skill，記錄技巧但不當作全部背部有效力量組數
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

classPlan.notes: Tue獨立Pull力量日，不再摻Bench或重腿。Petra Skill/Strength週二可取代

sessions.name: MON · LEGS
sessions.purpose: Independent squat + hinge strength
sessions.details: 0–2 easy round finisher is not Station main

classPlan.subtitle: LEGS｜World Gym 深蹲＋髖伸
classPlan.warmup: 5–10分鐘循序漸進暖身＋主要槓鈴動作的準備組

blocks.title: LEGS · A Squat / Hinge
steps: Back Squat 3×5–6 @RIR2
Romanian Deadlift 2×6–8 @RIR2
記錄實際重量、sets/reps/RIR；Squat與Hinge不要都練到力竭
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

blocks.title: LEGS · B Single Leg / Hamstring
steps: Reverse Lunge 或 Step-up 2×6–8/腿（若小腿/膝無痛）
Leg Curl 2×8–12
Low Step-down 1–2×8/腿；疼痛或腫脹時減少腿量
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

blocks.title: LEGS · C TECHNIQUE Finisher
steps: 選配：Sled Push 10m（技術負重）＋Easy Row 150m，最多2輪
這2輪只是腿日收尾，不計入當週Station主課的容量
有Petra腿部Strength、高強度WOD或腿痛就不做Finisher
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

blocks.title: Petra Strength / Skill 動態替代
blocks.format: 只能SUN / MON / TUE 其中一天，最多一堂，可不去
steps: 如果週一去Petra Strength，按實際練到的肌群取代World Gym腿日相應組數；別重複練一遍
如果是Skill輕技巧，不能假設已完成全部有效力量組數；可降低週量或下週再補
不為湊滿訓練天數堆疊額外課
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

classPlan.notes: Mon主練腿、蹲與髖伸。2輪技巧Finisher≠Station主課；Petra週一Strength可替代

sessions.name: SAT · STATION MAIN
sessions.purpose: 4–5 round main station with RPE/structured rests
sessions.details: No Wed hard Petra WOD + adequate Thu recovery required

classPlan.subtitle: STATION MAIN｜SKIERG + CARRY + WALL BALL
classPlan.warmup: 5–10分鐘循序漸進暖身＋主要槓鈴動作的準備組

blocks.title: 主Station工作組
steps: 5 ROUNDS：SkiErg 450m → Farmer Carry 35–40m → Wall Ball 6kg ×10–12
每輪休75–90秒；全程維持接近的Ski split，不要最後一輪衝到力竭
小腿/膝不適時減少Wall Ball，週三已上硬Petra WOD則取消這堂主課
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

blocks.title: 與週三Petra WOD的二選一規則
blocks.format: 只有沒上週三硬WOD、週四跑課恢復良好才做
steps: 週三如果已參加Petra硬WOD→Sat主Station取消，改Easy Ski/Row或休息
週三沒去Petra WOD→可做這堂完整4–5輪主課，但週四間歇尚未恢復就降強度/取消
本堂才是正式Station容量，Mon/Fri的2輪只是技巧Finisher
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

blocks.title: 練後記錄
steps: 記錄每輪Ski/Row split、Sled重量與距離、RPE與休息秒數
再記膝/小腿疼痛0–10與隔天反應；下週只增加一個訓練變項
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

classPlan.notes: 真的Station主課通常4–5輪、22–40分鐘；不是2輪Finisher，不用跑步機

sessions.name: SUN LONG EASY or one optional Petra Strength/Skill
sessions.purpose: Easy running base or optional Petra class substitution
sessions.details: Flexible; no forced long run after Sat hard station

classPlan.subtitle: LONG EASY｜戶外跑／Petra Strength·Skill選配
classPlan.warmup: 5–10分鐘循序漸進暖身＋主要槓鈴動作的準備組

blocks.title: Long Easy / Aerobic Base
steps: 戶外Easy Run 50–60分鐘，能講完整句子
如週六Station使腿部疲勞，縮短或改日；腿/膝有痛則改無痛低衝擊或休息
Ski/Row距離不能計入實際跑量
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

blocks.title: Petra Strength / Skill
blocks.format: SUN、MON、TUE其中一天可選，最多一堂
steps: 週日若去Petra Strength或Skill，根據實際肌群與RPE替代相似World Gym訓練；Long Easy可移日或取消
若週一或週二去Petra，週日就不再加第二堂Petra Strength/Skill
完全沒有去Petra Strength/Skill也是正常執行方案，不必補課
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

classPlan.notes: Sunday Long Easy，或至多一堂Sun/Mon/Tue的Petra Strength/Skill作替代，不需要兩者都做

weeks.check: 記錄站點後前200m跑速與喘感
notes: 不要同週同時增加跑量、力量重量和站點次數
依當週 Garmin＋Petra 更新已完成刺激後再微調
Petra高強度已足時Engine改Z2；長跑日晚上可加非高強度雙訓。
正式WOD一週僅1堂，由Petra、World Gym或Home擇一。
5天版不會假裝能同時完成3堂增肌＋跑間歇＋長跑＋WOD：輪流練2個肌群主軸，6天才完整3分化。
本週HYROX增肌與WOD劑量按periodization調整，力量先有效組數再做同主題功能循環。
獨立WOD僅一堂，若Petra上WOD即替代；日程按家庭時間與恢復自由排列。

structure.fiveDayRule: Preserve three PPL topics when possible, Thursday Petra running and one of Sat Station / Sun Easy depending on recovery; don't force missed workout makeups.
structure.sixDayRule: Mon Legs Tue Pull Fri Push + Thu Running + Sat conditional Main Station + Sun movable Easy/Long. Optional Petra Strength/Skill Sun/Mon/Tue substitutes matched work, Wed Petra WOD substitutes Sat.
structure.recover: If calf/knee symptoms or persistent DOMS, lower volume, take Easy/Rest and do not stack hard sessions.

periodization.weeklyRule: Mon LEGS／Tue PULL／Fri PUSH（WFH）。Petra Strength/Skill僅Sun/Mon/Tue選一堂，非必去；Wed WOD可選，Thu固定跑課。Sat Station MAIN 5輪，22–40分鐘。力量後0–2輪不算Station主課。
periodization.benchmark: 記錄站點後前200m跑速與喘感
periodization.hingePrescription: Conventional Barbell Deadlift（傳統槓鈴硬舉） 2×4–5 @RIR3
periodization.strengthAnchor: PPL: Mon LEGS / Tue PULL / Fri PUSH
periodization.strengthRule: 轉換第1週：硬舉維持，不追重；WOD練跑後Ski/BBJ

highIntensityDistribution.saturdayWorldGymStation: 4-5 rounds if no Wed hard and recovered
highIntensityDistribution.petraStrengthSkill: Optional one of Sun/Mon/Tue and substitute
highIntensityDistribution.summary: Hard cardiometabolic sessions generally <=2/week, recovery <=1. Wed hard WOD displaces Sat and scales Thu. Mon/Tue/Fri PPL anchors and optional Sun/Mon/Tue Petra strength replace matched work.

runningPlan.note: 跑步單獨安排，不佔星期日到星期六的 Station／力量主課；建議把品質跑與WOD或重腿錯開。

steps: 55分鐘可完整說話的輕鬆跑
依最近實際跑量與恢復調整，不用固定跑速

steps: 暖身10–12分鐘 → 5×800m，間隔2分鐘Easy

blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

blocks.title: 主Station工作組
steps: 5 ROUNDS：RowErg 350m → Sled Push 15m → Sled Pull 15m
每輪休90秒，雪橇採可控技術負重，不是每組Max

blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

classPlan.warmup: 5–10分鐘循序漸進暖身＋主要槓鈴動作的準備組

blocks.title: Long Easy / Aerobic Base
steps: 戶外Easy Run 50–60分鐘，能講完整句子
如週六Station使腿部疲勞，縮短或改日；腿/膝有痛則改無痛低衝擊或休息
Ski/Row距離不能計入實際跑量
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

blocks.title: Petra Strength / Skill
blocks.format: SUN、MON、TUE其中一天可選，最多一堂
steps: 週日若去Petra Strength或Skill，根據實際肌群與RPE替代相似World Gym訓練；Long Easy可移日或取消
若週一或週二去Petra，週日就不再加第二堂Petra Strength/Skill
完全沒有去Petra Strength/Skill也是正常執行方案，不必補課
blocks.note: 依實際出席、疼痛及恢復調整；未完成不可記為已完成

classPlan.notes: Sunday Long Easy，或至多一堂Sun/Mon/Tue的Petra Strength/Skill作替代，不需要兩者都做

notes: 不要同週同時增加跑量、力量重量和站點次數
依當週 Garmin＋Petra 更新已完成刺激後再微調
Petra高強度已足時Engine改Z2；長跑日晚上可加非高強度雙訓。
正式WOD一週僅1堂，由Petra、World Gym或Home擇一。
5天版不會假裝能同時完成3堂增肌＋跑間歇＋長跑＋WOD：輪流練2個肌群主軸，6天才完整3分化。
本週HYROX增肌與WOD劑量按periodization調整，力量先有效組數再做同主題功能循環。
獨立WOD僅一堂，若Petra上WOD即替代；日程按家庭時間與恢復自由排列。

structure.fiveDayRule: Preserve three PPL topics when possible, Thursday Petra running and one of Sat Station / Sun Easy depending on recovery; don't force missed workout makeups.
structure.sixDayRule: Mon Legs Tue Pull Fri Push + Thu Running + Sat conditional Main Station + Sun movable Easy/Long. Optional Petra Strength/Skill Sun/Mon/Tue substitutes matched work, Wed Petra WOD substitutes Sat.
structure.recover: If calf/knee symptoms or persistent DOMS, lower volume, take Easy/Rest and do not stack hard sessions.

periodization.weeklyRule: Mon LEGS／Tue PULL／Fri PUSH（WFH）。Petra Strength/Skill僅Sun/Mon/Tue選一堂，非必去；Wed WOD可選，Thu固定跑課。Sat Station MAIN 5輪，22–40分鐘。力量後0–2輪不算Station主課。
periodization.strengthAnchor: PPL: Mon LEGS / Tue PULL / Fri PUSH
periodization.strengthRule: 轉換第2週：重訓減量，讓雪橇WOD成為重點

highIntensityDistribution.petraStrengthSkill: Optional one of Sun/Mon/Tue and substitute
highIntensityDistribution.summary: Hard cardiometabolic sessions generally <=2/week, recovery <=1. Wed hard WOD displaces Sat and scales Thu. Mon/Tue/Fri PPL anchors and optional Sun/Mon/Tue Petra strength replace matched work.

structure.fiveDayRule: Preserve three PPL topics when possible, Thursday Petra running and one of Sat Station / Sun Easy depending on recovery; don't force missed workout makeups.
structure.sixDayRule: Mon Legs Tue Pull Fri Push + Thu Running + Sat conditional Main Station + Sun movable Easy/Long. Optional Petra Strength/Skill Sun/Mon/Tue substitutes matched work, Wed Petra WOD substitutes Sat.
structure.recover: If calf/knee symptoms or persistent DOMS, lower volume, take Easy/Rest and do not stack hard sessions.

periodization.weeklyRule: Mon LEGS／Tue PULL／Fri PUSH（WFH）。Petra Strength/Skill僅Sun/Mon/Tue選一堂，非必去；Wed WOD可選，Thu固定跑課。Sat Station MAIN 5輪，22–40分鐘。力量後0–2輪不算Station主課。
periodization.benchmark: WOD各輪Wall Ball是否出現無效動作
periodization.strengthAnchor: PPL: Mon LEGS / Tue PULL / Fri PUSH
periodization.strengthRule: 轉換第3週：力量維持，Wall Ball 後程效率優先

highIntensityDistribution.summary: Hard cardiometabolic sessions generally <=2/week, recovery <=1. Wed hard WOD displaces Sat and scales Thu. Mon/Tue/Fri PPL anchors and optional Sun/Mon/Tue Petra strength replace matched work.

structure.fiveDayRule: Preserve three PPL topics when possible, Thursday Petra running and one of Sat Station / Sun Easy depending on recovery; don't force missed workout makeups.
structure.sixDayRule: Mon Legs Tue Pull Fri Push + Thu Running + Sat conditional Main Station + Sun movable Easy/Long. Optional Petra Strength/Skill Sun/Mon/Tue substitutes matched work, Wed Petra WOD substitutes Sat.

programArchitecture.rationale: Three clearly separated PPL main strength days Mon Legs Tue Pull Fri Push WFH, Sunday Long Easy or optional Petra Strength/Skill, Wed Petra WOD optional and Thu interval fixed, Sat true Station main 4–5 rounds conditional.
programArchitecture.modeFive: Core Mon LEGS Tue PULL Fri PUSH, Thu Petra Interval, Sat station main conditional, Sun Easy/Long flexible. Petra Strength/Skill only one Sun/Mon/Tue as substitute; Wed WOD substitutes Sat.
programArchitecture.hardDays: Wed Petra hard WOD replaces Sat main; Thu run must downscale. Without Wed hard WOD, Thu quality and Sat station may be the two hard sessions when recovered.
programArchitecture.setTargets: PPL main work 2–3 sets on key moves, accessory 1–3, optional easy 0–2 round station technique finisher vs main station Sat 4–5 rounds
programArchitecture.progression: Mesocycle progression: W1 recovery gate; W2–3 build; W4 deload; W5–7 hypertrophy capacity; W8 deload; W9–11 compromised HYROX; W12 deload; W13 pacing; W14 sub-maximal consecutive-day rehearsal; W15 sharpening; W16 taper; W17 two-day race. WOD only one weekly slot.
programArchitecture.family: Sun Long Easy or Petra S/S optional; Mon Legs; Tue Pull; Wed Petra WOD optional; Thu Petra run fixed; Fri Push WFH; Sat Station Main conditional
programArchitecture.safety: 小腿/膝蓋疼痛、腫脹、步態不穩時改恢復替代方案，必要時尋求專業評估；不依賴單一Garmin心率判斷傷情。
programArchitecture.wodStyle: Main Sat SkiErg emphasized 4–5 rounds, 22–40min, Sled/Row/Carry/WB varied; Deload 2–3 easy rounds only technique, W14 Fri 8 station abbreviated simulation, W16 taper.
programArchitecture.defaultView: 17-week daily calendar plus independent running and complete Station main work details
programArchitecture.strengthHinge: Heavy squat/hinge belongs to Monday Legs; Tuesday Pull no heavy deadlift; Friday Push bench primary; W14 Fri 8-station simulation replaces heavy Push.
programArchitecture.strengthModel: 3 separate PPL foundational strength days with phase-appropriate 2–3 main work sets, 1–3 accessory sets, actual kg/reps/RIR; low intensity 0–2 round station techniques are supplementary, NOT main.
programArchitecture.intensityDesign: Max 2 hard cardio sessions (recovery <=1), Wed hard WOD replaces Sat, Thu scaled. Finisher 2 easy rounds not Station main.
programArchitecture.weeklyTemplate: SUN Long Easy or Petra Strength/Skill; MON WG LEGS; TUE WG PULL; WED Petra WOD optional; THU Petra Interval no World Gym; FRI WG PUSH (WFH); SAT Station MAIN conditional

weeklyScheduleNotes: If hard Wed Petra WOD, Thu class downscale easy/technical, Sat no hard WOD; if Thu cannot downscale, skip Wed hard WOD.

hingeDesign.concept: Fundamental strength patterns (Squat, Bench, Hinge/Deadlift, upper push/pull) have different roles across blocks, not mandatory every session or arbitrary weekly rotation. W05-W07 repeated Trap-bar and Bench as measurable build anchors; deload W04/W08/W12/W16; maintenance during HYROX-specific build.
hingeDesign.priority: Primary lift performed first with full recovery; at most one heavy hinge focus per week. Bench technique appears on Pull-dominant weeks for continuity; direct upper pulling remains alongside pressing.

stageDetails.foundation: W01–03 以Squat／Bench／拉背及六角槓技術建立工作組；W04 降載。基礎動作優先於高心率補量。
stageDetails.build: W05–07 以連續三週的六角槓力量與臥推漸進，Squat作次主項，維持背部肌量；W08降載。
stageDetails.transfer: W09–11 保留少量高品質Squat/Bench/Hinge，力量維持讓位給Run→Station、Sled、Carry與Wall Ball；W12降載。
stageDetails.specific: W13–15 只保留必要的力量刺激，W14縮量八站模擬期間取消重硬舉；重點是隔天仍能恢復。
stageDetails.taper: W16 降低力量訓練量，不再做重型硬舉；W17週五混雙、週六男單。

hingeDesign.evidence: 2026 ACSM position stand supports progressive RT, 2–3 quality sets for strength, and adequate weekly hypertrophy volume. Sports-specific block choices for HYROX are coaching design, not evidence that one periodization method must always outperform non-periodized training.
hingeDesign.log: Actual weights and 1RM are unknown in Strength_Log; choose loads by RIR and progress one variable at a time. No prescribed maximal testing.
hingeDesign.notes: W03 light conventional barbell hinge technical exposure @RIR4; W09 later maintenance @RIR3. W05–W07 same trap-bar DL repeated for actual progressive strength development; no heavy hinge plus heavy RDL in one week.

strengthProgression.loadProgression: Main progressive lifts 2–3 work sets by phase with kg/reps/RIR logged. Petra Strength/Skill Sun/Mon/Tue substitutes matched sets, not stacked. Not all muscles must be trained to failure.
strengthProgression.recovery: Heavy lower-body sessions adjusted for Friday WOD and separate quality running sessions; no additional high-intensity finisher on maximal strength focus days.

intensityModel.principle: Station main 4–5 rounds 22–40min Sat conditional; Mon/Fri 0–2 easy skill rounds only. Wed hard Petra WOD replaces Sat; Thu run scaled. Two hard cardio sessions per week maximum after recovery, less on deload.
intensityModel.limitation: The run quality session is optional when Tuesday and Friday quality workouts are both done; do not inadvertently turn the weekly program into 3–4 mandatory high-intensity days. Petra session, if actually performed, counts toward quality work rather than stacking extra.
intensityModel.priority: Keep weekly total load manageable across Garmin runs, World Gym/Petra strength, Ski/Row and mixed WOD; prioritize form and repeated splits over exhaustion.

coordination: Two main high days across tracks: running intervals + one WOD (when included); Tuesday station moderate if quality run is done.
Long Easy can be paired with easy Ski/Row on same day with hours between sessions; the app leaves running time flexible.
Do not infer attendance from Petra photo alone; wait for activity or verified notes to confirm individual WOD performance.
Plan for progressive strength volume/skill and schedule deloads W04,W08,W12,W16; do not treat ordinary post-workout soreness as weakness, but do not train through persistent pain.
trainingTracks.privacy: Public report contains aggregated data only, no raw FIT, GPS coordinates or private photos
